name: UK National Curriculum — Key Stage 4 (GCSE)
description: Key Stage 4 culminates in GCSE examinations (General Certificate of Secondary Education). Most subjects offer Foundation tier (grades 1–5) and Higher tier (grades 4–9). GCSEs are taken at age 15–16.
gradeScale: 9 (highest) → 1 (lowest). Grade 4 = standard pass. Grade 5 = strong pass.
assessmentNote: GCSEs are primarily assessed by written examinations in summer of Year 11, with some coursework/controlled assessment components for certain subjects.
